name: com.fillr.nativeautofill.FillrNativeAutofillService
description: Android invokes Fillr's native autofill service when a user focuses a supported form field or saves a form. Fillr matches form fields to its saved profile and offers suggestions, then handles details the user chooses to save.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Android from offering Fillr profile data or saving new details through the system autofill feature.
